title: 156th Brigade Engineer Battalion rolls out in support of Hurricane Harvey
description: Capt. Brian McCauley and 2nd Lt. Stephanie Jasper discuss their mission in Hurricane Harvey recovery efforts and the challenges that came with it.
keywords: disaster response, Harvey, 128th MPAD, UTNG, Texas Military Department, Hurricane Harvey, 156th brigade engineer battalion, 156th bb, National Guard, Texas, Hurricane, Utah

transcript.text: - So our mission with the 156 BEB,
We were the Battalion Mission Command.
We did everything from evacuate, high water evacuations,
house-to-house evacuations,
to setting up a triage at the local mall.
We would see what the best need and the best fit was
and move them around, day-by-day.
- I think the most difficult thing was
that the mission was constantly changing,
so we had to be quick on our feet to adapt
to whatever our commands.
Mission changing constantly.
And then being able to give those commands
off to the people that worked subordinate to us.
- Another great thing about this whole thing was
just the outpouring of support from the local populace.
Of showing us love, showing us support, bringing us food,
and if we needed coolers or refrigerators,
or whatever we needed, they were there to help us out,
just to keep our operations going 24 hours a day.
- I think I would like most people to know that
even though we're leaving the area,
we're definitely not abandoning this mission.
We have people taking our place.
The Oklahoma Guard is there taking over our mission.
We still very much have a presence here,
and we're going to be here until it's over.
